name: Wagepoint
description_en:
Wagepoint is cloud payroll for Canadian small businesses, accountants and bookkeepers. It documents employee/contractor pay, direct deposit, payroll calculations, remittances, year-end forms, Records of Employment, reporting and employee access; it currently says it serves Canada only.

Plan selection depends on pay-run frequency: Solo allows one run and one pay group monthly, while Unlimited supports multiple runs and groups. Subscription fees are separate from the wages and statutory funds that the employer must provide on time.
description_zh:
Wagepoint 是面向加拿大小企业、会计及记账人员的云工资系统，文档涵盖员工承包人员付款、直接存款、工资计算、缴款、年末表单、离职记录、报表和员工访问，当前明确仅服务加拿大。

套餐按工资频率选择：Solo 每月一次、一个工资组，Unlimited 支持多次及多组。订阅费与雇主必须按时提供的工资和法定资金分开。

core_features.explanation_en: The vendor describes income-tax, EI/CPP, T4/T4A, ROE, direct deposit and reporting, with provincial conditions to verify.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商描述所得税、EI/CPP、T4/T4A、ROE、直接存款及报表，省级条件需核实。

core_features.name_zh: 预览及自定义工资编码
core_features.explanation_en: Review a payroll before submission and configure income, deduction and benefit codes for the required payment components.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提交前审核工资，并为所需付款组成配置收入、扣款和福利编码。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees can manage onboarding/banking details and pay documents; My Wagepoint describes time entries flowing to payroll.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工可管理入职银行资料及工资文档，My Wagepoint 描述工时进入工资。

pricing.summary_en: Solo $20/month+$4/person for one run/group; Unlimited $40+$6/person. Invoice currency needs confirmation. Verified-company 14-day trial and conditional Q4 discount; taxes and payroll funds separate.
pricing.summary_zh: Solo 月$20加每人$4，限一次及一组；Unlimited $40加每人$6。发票币种待确认；验证企业可14天试用，Q4优惠有条件。税及工资资金分开。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Select the plan by actual pay frequency
sections.title_zh: 按实际发薪频率选套餐
sections.en: Solo is listed at $20 monthly plus $4 per employee or contractor, with one pay run and one pay group each month. Unlimited is $40 plus $6 per person, with unlimited runs and pay groups. An employer paying weekly needs the latter’s frequency scope rather than treating Solo as four weekly runs for one base fee. For five people, the stated standard formula is $40 Solo or $70 Unlimited before applicable taxes or special usage. The captured page uses the dollar symbol without an explicit currency code in its rate text, so invoice currency remains to confirm rather than silently normalizing it.
sections.zh: Solo 列出月费 $20 加每员工或承包人员 $4，每月一次工资及一个工资组；Unlimited 为 $40 加每人 $6，不限次数和工资组。每周发薪的雇主需要后者频率范围，不能把 Solo 当作一笔基础费可跑四次周薪。五人按标准公式为 Solo $40、Unlimited $70，未计适用税及特殊用量。捕获价目只使用 $，费率正文未明确币种代码，因此发票币种保留待确认，不静默归一。

sections.title_en: Reconcile an exception before relying on Auto-run
sections.title_zh: 依赖自动运行前核对异常
sections.en: The payroll page describes preview, adjustments, custom codes, reminders and an Auto-run option. Employee self-service covers TD1 and banking details, paystubs and tax documents; contractors have pay statements and T4As. A useful parallel cycle would include a bonus, reimbursement and mid-cycle salary change, then compare calculations, liabilities, deposits and reports with the existing payroll source. The vendor’s broad Canada-wide capability and accounting-sync claims were not independently tested. Confirm provincial requirements, worker classification, exact accounting direction and correction handling in a configured demonstration.
sections.zh: 工资页描述预览、调整、自定义编码、提醒及 Auto-run。员工自助涵盖 TD1、银行资料、工资单和税务文件，承包人员有付款明细及 T4A。并行期间可包括奖金、报销及期中调薪，再对照既有工资核对计算、负债、存款和报告。加拿大广泛覆盖及会计同步说法未经独立测试，需在配置演示中确认省级要求、人员分类、会计方向及更正。

sections.title_en: Fund payroll separately from service fees
sections.title_zh: 工资资金与服务费分开准备
sections.en: Terms distinguish service fees from Payroll Funds, which include wages, statutory remittances and agreed third-party payments. They describe attempted collection three banking days before payday unless a different written arrangement applies, and warn insufficient funds can delay employee payment and affect future direct-deposit privileges. A scheduled run is therefore not a guarantee of funded payment. Confirm the authorization, cutoff, verification and bank-failure process before rollout; do not retry a rejected payment without identifying the actual state with support. No funding or reversal was attempted here.
sections.zh: 条款区分服务费与 Payroll Funds，后者包含工资、法定缴款及约定第三方付款。除书面另约，条款描述发薪前三个银行日尝试收款，并提示余额不足可延迟付款和影响后续直接存款资格。因此排好工资不保证资金到位。上线前需确认授权、截止、验证及银行失败处理，拒付后应先与支持核实状态再处理，不能盲目重试。本研究未供款或撤销付款。

sections.title_en: The current offer requires an actual first payroll
sections.title_zh: 当前优惠要求真正完成首次工资
sections.en: The pricing page advertises a 14-day trial, including payroll only if the company is verified, and includes year-end forms and support without additional standard charges. Q4 2026 terms offer eligible first-time customers 75% off monthly subscription and per-employee fees for six months, if they sign up and complete first payroll within October 14–December 31, 2026. Returning customers, prior promotions and combinations are restricted. After six months then-current prices apply and monthly charges continue until cancellation. The trial and offer are not a sustained free plan. Terms say paid fees are non-refundable and exclude applicable taxes; exact signup and cancellation terms should be confirmed.
sections.zh: 价格页宣传 14 天试用，只有企业已验证才能试运行工资，并称年末表单和支持不另收标准费。2026 年第四季度条款给合资格首次客户前六个月订阅及人均费优惠 75%，要求在 10 月 14 日至 12 月 31 日间注册并完成首次工资，回流客户、旧优惠及叠加受限。六个月后适用当时价格，取消前继续月度收费。试用和优惠不是长期免费套餐。条款称已付服务费不退且税另计，具体注册和取消需确认。

sections.title_en: Resolve support hours and data exit requirements
sections.title_zh: 确认支持时间及数据退出要求
sections.en: The pricing footer advertises support Monday–Friday 8 AM–8 PM ET, while the reviewed terms say generally 8 AM–5 PM ET excluding observed holidays. Resolve that difference, especially around funding deadlines. Wagepoint may suit Canadian small teams or firms managing client payrolls; employers elsewhere need a different country scope. Prepare payroll identifiers, YTD balances, pay groups, codes and approvers, and test a rejected bank detail and corrected report. Hosting, retention, complete exports, accountant permissions, security controls and recovery remain unverified. No tenant, Auto-run, calculation, filing, transfer or integration was executed; no open-source license was established.
sections.zh: 价格页页脚宣传工作日 ET 8:00–20:00 支持，所读条款则写通常 8:00–17:00、节假日除外，需尤其在资金截止前澄清。加拿大小团队或管理客户工资的事务所可评估 Wagepoint，其他国家雇主需要不同范围。需准备工资编号、年内累计、工资组、编码及审批人，并测试错误银行资料及更正报告。托管、保留、完整导出、会计权限、安全控制和恢复未核实，未执行租户、自动运行、计算、申报、转账或集成，也未确立开源许可。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
